text:
Lena: small flex + tiny celebration ask — accepted a senior engineering manager role today 🎉 and we just closed on a new place in the East Bay 🏡. thinking of doing a casual housewarming + office potluck next Friday evening. zero pressure, just snacks, a plant, and bad apartment-assembling stories. thoughts?
Jonah: huge congrats, Lena!!! double win. potluck = yes. i will bring something cheesy, probably literal cheesy garlic bread. :cheese:
Priya: congrats!! can we do a quick RSVP so you know numbers? evening works better for me. also would folks prefer drinks + finger food or full dinner?
Lena: thanks!! yes evening is best. leaning drinks + finger food so people can drop by. if anyone wants to bring a side dish thatd9s great. also we're short on plates/cutlery — if someone can bring disposables that'd help.
Marco: i'll bring a set of disposable plates and cups. and i have a tiny welcome plant i can donate.
Kiki: Kiki (will bring a salad). also will bring a toolbox for any un-boxing emergencies 🧰
Sam: Sam (will bring sparkling water + non-alcoholic options). congrats lena! any theme?
Lena: no theme — just comfy clothes and stories about ikea furniture that betrayed us. RSVP template (copy/paste into thread):
```
RSVP - Lena housewarming + office potluck
Date: Fri, Jun 11
Time: 7:00pm - 9:30pm
Location: Lena's place (Oakland)
Attendees:
- Lena (host)
```
Jonah: Jonah (bringing cheesy garlic bread)
Priya: Priya (brings a dessert)
Marco: Marco (plates + welcome plant)
Kiki: Kiki (salad + toolbox)
Sam: Sam (sparkling water)
Lena: also quick ask: if anyone wants to chip in for a tiny housewarming plant fund (no pressure), i'll collect in person.
deploy-bot: Reminder: team offsite planning survey closes Thu 5pm — don't forget to vote!
Priya: quick poll — do we want this to be kid/pet friendly? Lena has a cat but also it'll be low-key.
Lena: pet friendly is fine; my cat is shy and will hide but there are usually no issues. kids welcome but note it's a small place.
Marco: ::poll:: Pets welcome / Adults only / Kids welcome too
Jonah: also FYI if you plan to park: therere two street permit spots nearby, email me and i'll forward the exact coordinates.
Kiki: anyone interested in a pre-event ikea run for extra storage shelves? i'm free Fri afternoon and can swing by with a dolly.
Lena: love the help. thank you all — excited to host. if you can't make it but still want to send a tiny card, DM me and i'll add it to the keepsake box. ❤️
